The documented schema is the shared GraphQL-Markdown demo schema, loaded from its URL at generation time. Generated pages are written to docs/graphql.

graphql/mutations-archive-project.html.title: archiveProject
graphql/mutations-archive-project.html.body:
archiveProject mutation

  On this page
  ArgumentsTypeExample





Archive a project that is no longer active.
archiveProject(
  id: ID!
): Project!

Arguments
archiveProject.id ● ID! non-null scalar 
The unique identifier of the project to archive.
Type
Project object
A unit of work tracked in the workspace.
Example
mutation ArchiveProject($id: ID!) {
  archiveProject(id: $id) {
    id
    name
    status
    updatedAt
  }
}

graphql/mutations-create-folder.html.title: createFolder
graphql/mutations-create-folder.html.body:
createFolder mutation

  On this page
  ArgumentsTypeExample





Create a virtual folder in the workspace.
createFolder(
  name: String!
  parentId: ID
): Folder!

Arguments
createFolder.name ● String! non-null scalar 
The name of the new folder.
createFolder.parentId ● ID scalar 
The optional parent folder identifier.
Type

    name
  }
}

graphql/mutations-create-project.html.title: createProject
graphql/mutations-create-project.html.body:
createProject mutation

  On this page
  ArgumentsTypeExample





Create a project and assign its initial owner.

  input: CreateProjectInput!
): Project!

Arguments
createProject.input ● CreateProjectInput! non-null input 
The project attributes to create.
Type
Project object
A unit of work tracked in the workspace.
Example

    }

}

graphql/subscriptions-project-changed.ht.title: projectChanged
graphql/subscriptions-project-changed.ht.body:
projectChanged subscription

  On this page
  ArgumentsTypeExample





Receive an event whenever a project changes in the workspace.
projectChanged(
  projectId: ID
  types: [ProjectEventType!]
): ProjectEvent!

Arguments
projectChanged.projectId ● ID scalar 
Limit events to a single project.
projectChanged.types ● [ProjectEventType!] list enum 
Limit events to these change kinds.
Type
ProjectEvent object
A change delivered to subscribers watching a project.
Example
subscription WatchProject($projectId: ID, $types: [ProjectEventType!]) {
  projectChanged(projectId: $projectId, types: $types) {
    type
    occurredAt
    project {
      id
      name
      status
    }
    actor {
      name
    }
  }
}

graphql/objects-project.html.title: Project
graphql/objects-project.html.body:
Project object

  On this page
  FieldsInterfacesExampleReturned ByMember OfImplemented By





A unit of work tracked in the workspace.
type Project implements Node {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  status: ProjectStatus!
  owner: User!
  folder: Folder
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  state: String @deprecated
}

Fields
Project.id ● ID! non-null scalar 
The unique identifier of the project.
Project.name ● String! non-null scalar 
The project name shown to collaborators.
Project.status ● ProjectStatus! non-null enum 
The current lifecycle stage of the project.
Project.owner ● User! non-null object 
The user responsible for the project.
Project.folder ● Folder object 
The folder containing this project, when assigned.
Project.updatedAt ● DateTime! non-null scalar 
When the project was last updated.
Project.state ● String deprecated scalar 

WARNING - DEPRECATED

Replaced by the ProjectStatus enum on status.
The project's lifecycle stage.
Interfaces
Node interface
A globally unique entity identifier.
Example
{
  "id": "project_01",
  "name": "Mobile Refresh",
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "owner": {
    "id": "user_01",
    "name": "Avery Chen"
  },
  "updatedAt": "2026-09-05T10:15:00Z"
}

Returned By

Member Of

Implemented By

graphql/scalars-id.html.title: ID
graphql/scalars-id.html.body:
ID scalar
The ID scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as "4") or integer (such as 4) input value will be accepted as an ID.
scalar ID

graphql/directives-deprecated.html.title: deprecated
graphql/directives-deprecated.html.body:
deprecated directive
Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.
directive @deprecated(
  reason: String!
) on 
  | FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
  | INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ENUM_VALUE
  | DIRECTIVE_DEFINITION

Arguments
deprecated.reason ● String! non-null scalar 
Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by CommonMark.
